us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}This tower, wrought by Hands Undying,{line}Heaven-bound path.{page}{center:8180}Its myriad ways cannot be walked{line}By those of the world below.{page}{center:8180}Those who trespass here in avarice{line}Will pay with tears.{page}{center:8180}They who master Power, Wisdom, Mist...{line}The tower's secrets are for them,{line}And them alone.
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Unsterblich sind Wir, die Erbauer{line}dieses Turmes, der gar den Himmel{line}zu überragen vermag.{page}{center:8180}Die Schneise des Lebens ward von Uns{line}erdacht. Das Fatum Wir diktieren,{line}das nicht den Lebenden vermacht.{page}{center:8180}Wahre Stärke, tiefgründige Weisheit,{line}dämonische Mysth. Alles sollst du haben{line}oder du bist dem Verderben geweiht.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Esta torre, por eternos seres{line}construida, al Cielo conduce.{page}{center:8180}Mas por ella no puede{line}cualquier mortal andar.{page}{center:8180}Quien por la codicia cegado{line}entre, con la vida lo pagará.{page}{center:8180}Solo aquel cuya fuerza, sabiduría y magia{line}auténticas sean, entrar y salir podrá.
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Construite de la main des Immortels,{line}cette tour conduit jusqu'au ciel.{page}{center:8180}Ses innombrables détours et méandres,{line}les hommes de ce monde ne peuvent entendre.{page}{center:8180}Ceux qui la foulent avec désir et envie,{line}paieront ce blasphème de leur misérable vie.{page}{center:8180}Seuls ceux qui montrent force et bravoure,{line}et pour la sagesse et le myste, amour,{line}verront s'ouvrir les secrets de la tour.
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}"Strada per il cielo è la torre,{line} eretta da mano immortale."{page}{center:8180}"Ma non per i mortali è stato{line} tracciato il cammino."{page}{center:8180}"La cieca brama brucia il destino."{page}{center:8180}"Vera forza, vera saggezza e magia del Mystes!{line} Solo chi le domina sarà padrone del cammino."

es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Las {color:8091}Esferas oscuras{color:BB808080} ahuyentan a las sombras.{line}  Ofrenda cierta cantidad y la luz regresará.{line}  Ofrenda más de la cuenta y se perderán en vano".

it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Per disperdere le tenebre usa le {color:8091}Perle nere{color:BB808080}.{line} La luce tornerà se inserisci la giusta quantità.{line} Ma se eccedi, tutto sarà stato fatto invano."
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「この闇を払いたくば{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}をおさめよ。{line}{blank}おさめし数に導かれ、やがて光おとずれん。{line}{blank}おさめし数が過ぎし時、珠吸い込まれ虚無とならん。」
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「이 어둠을 쫓고 싶으면 {color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}을 넣어라.{line} 넣은 개수에 이끌려, 빛이 찾아오리라.{line} 너무 많은 구슬을 넣으면, 구슬이 빨려 들어가 사라지리라.」
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想拔除这股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}随着放入的数量指引，光明终将到来。{line}{blank}当放入过量时，珠子将被吸入，化为虚无。」

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"{color:8091}Black orbs{color:BB808080} the darkness of this hall dispel.{line}In proper measure, light once more they bring.{line}In overabundance, for naught are they spent."
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Opfere die {color:8091}Schattenperlen{color:BB808080}, um das Dunkel{line}zu vertreiben. Stimmt ihre Zahl, erscheine{line}dir Licht, eine jede Perle sonst verblicht.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Las {color:8091}Esferas oscuras{color:BB808080} ahuyentan a las sombras.{line}  Ofrenda cierta cantidad y la luz regresará.{line}  Ofrenda más de la cuenta y se perderán en vano".
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}« Les {color:8091}orbes noirs{color:BB808080} savent les ténèbres dissiper.{line}Avec mesure, la lumière ils peuvent ramener.{line}Avec excès, pour rien ils sont gaspillés. »
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Per disperdere le tenebre usa le {color:8091}Perle nere{color:BB808080}.{line} La luce tornerà se inserisci la giusta quantità.{line} Ma se eccedi, tutto sarà stato fatto invano."
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「この闇を払いたくば{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}をおさめよ。{line}{blank}おさめし数に導かれ、やがて光おとずれん。{line}{blank}おさめし数が過ぎし時、珠吸い込まれ虚無とならん。」
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「이 어둠을 쫓고 싶으면 {color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}을 넣어라.{line} 넣은 개수에 이끌려, 빛이 찾아오리라.{line} 너무 많은 구슬을 넣으면, 구슬이 빨려 들어가 사라지리라.」
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想拔除这股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}随着放入的数量指引，光明终将到来。{line}{blank}当放入过量时，珠子将被吸入，化为虚无。」
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想袚除這股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}隨著放入的數量指引，光明終將到來。{line}{blank}當放入過量時，珠子將被吸入，化為虛無。」

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"{color:8091}Black orbs{color:BB808080} the darkness of this hall dispel.{line}In proper measure, light once more they bring.{line}In overabundance, for naught are they spent."
de: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{fixed-advance:8194}Opfere die {color:8091}Schattenperlen{color:BB808080}, um das Dunkel{line}zu vertreiben. Stimmt ihre Zahl, erscheine{line}dir Licht, eine jede Perle sonst verblicht.{fixed-advance:8180}
es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Las {color:8091}Esferas oscuras{color:BB808080} ahuyentan a las sombras.{line}  Ofrenda cierta cantidad y la luz regresará.{line}  Ofrenda más de la cuenta y se perderán en vano".
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}« Les {color:8091}orbes noirs{color:BB808080} savent les ténèbres dissiper.{line}Avec mesure, la lumière ils peuvent ramener.{line}Avec excès, pour rien ils sont gaspillés. »
it: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}"Per disperdere le tenebre usa le {color:8091}Perle nere{color:BB808080}.{line} La luce tornerà se inserisci la giusta quantità.{line} Ma se eccedi, tutto sarà stato fatto invano."
in: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「この闇を払いたくば{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}をおさめよ。{line}{blank}おさめし数に導かれ、やがて光おとずれん。{line}{blank}おさめし数が過ぎし時、珠吸い込まれ虚無とならん。」
kr: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「이 어둠을 쫓고 싶으면 {color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}을 넣어라.{line} 넣은 개수에 이끌려, 빛이 찾아오리라.{line} 너무 많은 구슬을 넣으면, 구슬이 빨려 들어가 사라지리라.」
cn: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想拔除这股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}随着放入的数量指引，光明终将到来。{line}{blank}当放入过量时，珠子将被吸入，化为虚无。」
ch: {spacing:8181}{actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}「想袚除這股黑暗就放入{color:8091}{arg:8090}{color:BB808080}吧。{line}{blank}隨著放入的數量指引，光明終將到來。{line}{blank}當放入過量時，珠子將被吸入，化為虛無。」

us: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Pilgrim impelled to Heaven's heights,{line}Skyward keep your course.{page}{center:8180}In Vessel of Sky now make your way.{line}Reaching this place, your worth proven,{line}The path for you shall open.

es: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Peregrino en ruta hacia el Cielo:{page}{center:8180}La plataforma flotante ha de llevarte{line}cuando tu preciosa ofrenda hayas recuperado.
fr: {actor-name:8180}{line}{speed:8180}{center:8180}Pèlerin par les hauteurs du ciel appelé,{line}poursuis ton ascension, le cœur de fiance gonflé.{page}{center:8180}Sur le vaisseau céleste une fois rivé,{line}tu devras à nouveau ta valeur prouver.{line}Ainsi s'ouvrira la voie, à ton arrivée.
